result.title: Continuous-Time Cloth Dynamics with Physics-Informed Neural ODEs
result.summary: We present ContinuousCloth, a continuous-time, physics-informed neural solver for deformable cloth dynamics that enforces a spring--mass ODE within a neural trajectory model. Unlike classical time-stepping simulators that return trajectories only on a discrete integration grid, ContinuousCloth supports querying at arbitrary timestamps and computing displacement, velocity, and acceleration via automatic differentiation. We evaluate ContinuousCloth along two dimensions. In a physics-only setting, ContinuousCloth achieves trajectory accuracy comparable to high-precision solvers across six diverse boundary-condition scenarios while reducing runtime by up to 17.4 times. When fused with sparse and noisy observations, the spring--mass ODE acts as a strong inductive bias for downstream tasks: interpolation and parameter estimation. That is, ContinuousCloth reduces interpolation error by 7.3 times over a data-only neural baseline in simulation and 2.4 times on real-world cloth sequences, and achieves 2.6 times lower parameter error than a differentiable-solver baseline under high-noise conditions, demonstrating consistent robustness under realistic measurement imperfections.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ContinuousCloth：以弹簧-质点 ODE 作为物理约束嵌入神经轨迹模型，实现连续时间布料动力学求解，支持任意时间戳查询并用自动微分得到位移、速度与加速度；评估涵盖纯物理设定的精度与加速，以及在稀疏噪声观测下的插值与参数估计。
AI.relevance_reason: 其连续时间 neural ODE 的隐状态演化与以物理方程充当归纳偏置的训练方式，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的连续更新、以及噪声观测下的监督与一致性约束提供可核查的方法线索，但论文属物理仿真领域，与 VLM 推理无直接关联。
